card.name: Space before a number or value
card.fires_on: A space token sitting right before a number or quantity, where a bracketed or parenthetical item has just ended or a new numeric value begins. It appears in dose schedules, step numbers, ages and device sizes.

modes.label: Dose or time value follows
modes.description: Space after a parenthetical or dose phrase, just before a time or amount.

modes.label: Size or range follows
modes.description: Space before a numeric size, duration, or age in instructions.

modes.label: Step or figure number follows
modes.description: Space before a step number in numbered instructions.

card.writes: It favors empty-parenthesis tokens and disfavors an opening bracket, so it mostly discourages a bracket coming next.
card.plain: It marks a spot where a number comes next, such as a dose, time, age or step, rather than a bracketed note.
